name: assure-whatsapp-sdk
description: TypeScript packages for Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform Cloud API — types, client, and webhook primitives.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @assure-ai/whatsapp-types && npm run build -w @assure-ai/whatsapp-webhooks && npm run build -w @assure-ai/whatsapp-api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc --noEmit -p examples/tsconfig.json
